description: This file defines a React component called StatusSummary that displays a live, compact status overview of tasks in a kanban board, including counts for To Do, In Progress, Done, and On Hold. It pulls data from a custom hook useKanban and normalizes various status strings to four standardized buckets.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: A helper function within the StatusSummary component that converts various status strings to one of four categories: 'todo', 'inprogress', 'done', 'hold'.
